notes.title: 2.0 Patch Update
notes.content:
[b]1. Skip function has been added.[/b]
A skip function has been added for the convenience of multiple playthroughs.
A skip button has been added to the far left of the story mode conversation window.
The skip function is activated after watching the ending at least once.

If you press skip
    1) Branching of conversation
    2) Training, just before battle
    3) End of chapter
will go.


[b]2. Log function has been added.[/b]
A log function has been added to review past conversations.
The log function can only check conversations in that chapter.
Please understand that once you pass the conversation branch, you will not be able to check the logs before the conversation branch.

notes.title: 1.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1) Added auto save.
Even if you accidentally quit without saving, the auto save will be saved in the load menu.
Auto save files save the steps immediately before the end point.
Auto-save is always updated on the screen you are playing, so please use it only to the extent that you can use it when it ends accidentally.

2) The special ending (heroine ending) conditions have been slightly lowered.

3) Fixed issues where the subject of dialogue was entered incorrectly in story mode (4 locations).

tags.feature: 1) Added auto save.

tags.balance_change: 2) The special ending (heroine ending) conditions have been slightly lowered.

tags.bug: 3) Fixed issues where the subject of dialogue was entered incorrectly in story mode (4 locations).

notes.title: 1.85 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1) Dubbing volume up
2) Reduces certain sound effects during battle.

Developer comment: There was feedback that the dubbing volume was low, so we raised it to a level that would not break it.
Also, the sound balance of certain combat hits felt jarring, so we adjusted the sound balance.
Instead, the capacity has become slightly larger, but please understand this.

3) Adjustment of enemy agility ability

Developer Comment: Although we've sped up the combat a lot, it's basically a slow game.
Therefore, I decided that you felt more annoyed than thrilled by the occasional enemy miss.
Accordingly, we have modified it to prevent enemies from making mistakes as much as possible.

4) Fixed some text typos

tags.balance_change: 2) Reduces certain sound effects during battle.

notes.title: Patch 1.8 (Feature Improvements)
notes.content:
[b][Battle part][/b]
The targeting box has been greatly enlarged (height) from the character's bottom circle.
We have modified it so that targeting can be done by clicking on the center of the character.

[b][etc][/b]
The esc button has been added as a shortcut for closing menus (save, load, options, help, etc.) that are closed with the x button.
*The help first page has also been modified due to the addition of the esc key function.

In addition, there were improvements to training and combat-related skip functions and features through yesterday's 1.7 patch.
Please refer to the link for more details.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/2525830/announcements/detail/3871471412513517643

notes.title: Patch 1.7 (feature improvements)
notes.content:
[b][Training part][/b]
1. Game over no longer occurs due to stress levels in the training part.
2. The ability to Rest has been modified to randomly specially strengthen one of the Boy's abilities, rather than reducing stress levels.
3. Supplementary explanations for training part tips have been added.
4. Help contents have been modified according to the modification of the training part.
5. The button at the top right of the training part has been modified to use the training skip function instead of Help output.
  -If you skip training, you will be compensated for the ability points that you completed with Good results in learning and physical training twice each.
*For system reasons, the number of part-time jobs that can be done per month is limited to a maximum of 3. (Part-time jobs cannot be scheduled after number 3.)

[b][Battle part][/b]
1. The skill costs of Boy, Saint, and Rosy have been reduced overall.
2. The speed at which 1 cost is recharged has been reduced from 2 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
3. The button at the top right of the battle part has been changed to a battle skip function rather than a function to go to the title.
  - Even if you skip, you will still receive one passive skill as a reward.


[b]Developer comments[/b]
I judged that quite a few users were experiencing stress during training and combat.
I made improvements in this area, but tried to reduce negative factors as much as possible.
For those who want to fully enjoy the story, a skip function has been added for both training and combat.

notes.title: Patch 1.6 (bug fixes and improvements)
notes.content:
[b]1. The battle cannot proceed without 4 cards in the battle deck.[/b]

Developer's comment: There was an issue where the battle did not proceed properly if less than 4 chapters were entered, so we were forced to block it.


[b]2. Double the text speed.[/b]

Developer Comment: It would be nice to add a text speed option, but at this point, all I can do is make it faster than before.
I ask for your understanding.

tags.bug: [b]1. The battle cannot proceed without 4 cards in the battle deck.[/b]

tags.feature: [b]2. Double the text speed.[/b]

notes.title: 1.6 patch rollback
notes.content:
I rolled back patch 1.6 due to issues with save files.
It was rolled back within 1-2 minutes, but if you have received the patch, I would appreciate it if you could reinstall it.

The 1.6 patch issue issues are as follows:
All save files are moved to the same part (the last saved content).

If you go back to the rolled back version, the save file will work without any problems, so if you have any of the above symptoms, please reinstall and play.

tags.bug: All save files are moved to the same part (the last saved content).

notes.title: 1.5 update
notes.content:
[b]1. Add style setting option[/b]
: The basic exposure of the game has been increased.
The places that have been modified are as follows:

   a) The exposure of title screen illustrations has increased.
   b) The exposure of the portraits and SD images of the 7 female characters has increased.
   c) The exposure of the event CG in story mode and the event CG confirmation section in extra has been increased.
   d) If you set the style level to 'conservative' in the options window, it will return to the exposure level of the first released version.


Developer Description: During the crowdfunding process for The Lost Prince, we received a lot of feedback about the exposure of female characters through the funding company, so we performed censorship work to significantly reduce the exposure of female characters.

However, as a result of consulting with the relevant agencies, it was decided that the 15-year-old rating could be maintained even with the pre-censored version. The basic exposure level was returned to the original work version (sexy), and after reviewing the content revision, it was decided to maintain the 15-year-old rating. It is done.

Accordingly, the exposure of the basic game has been updated to the original concept.
[b]However, this is an update that may be disliked by users who dislike exposure, so by selecting 'conservative' in the options window, you can enjoy the game with the lower exposure of the previous version.[/b]


[b]2. Save/load icon replacement[/b]
Developer Description: We have modified the content that received a lot of suggestions from users.
Even when I looked at it, the save and load images were confusing. It was done correctly in Help.

[b]3. Minor bug fixes[/b]
   - Fixed an issue where only two active items could be acquired per month through part-time work in the training part.
   - When you have acquired all 8 spare cards that can be obtained through part-time work in the training part, a warning will appear that you will no longer be able to acquire reward active skills if you continue working part-time.
   - If the battle deck is not filled with 4 cards in the battle preparation window, the warning message is changed to red to ensure visibility
